title: This AI test passes. Watch it test nothing.

scenes.heading: Spot the bug
scenes.say: This test passes. Spot the bug in three seconds.

scenes.heading: AI-written test
scenes.say: It patches the function under test with a fake that returns ninety, then checks for ninety. The real code never runs.

scenes.heading: Break the code
scenes.body:
discount -> markup

AI tests: 2 passed
Real tests: 2 failed
scenes.say: I turned the discount into a markup. The AI tests still pass. Real tests fail.

scenes.heading: Ask one question
scenes.body: What would make this test fail?
scenes.say: Ask one question of every test: what would make it fail? Full breakdown on the channel.
